title: SAM 3.1 image segment
description: Local text-prompted segmentation with Meta SAM 3.1 in ComfyUI. Name what to select (face, hair, jacket); the output is a white-on-black mask of the source image's size, used by the image editor as a selection.

requirements.name: sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Install the SAM 3.1 multiplex FP16 checkpoint into models/checkpoints and verify its SHA-256; review the Meta SAM license before use.

evidence: Graph follows the installed ComfyUI template utility_image_segment_sam3.json (comfyui-workflow-templates-json 0.1.92): CheckpointLoaderSimple feeds MODEL and CLIP, CLIPTextEncode carries the text prompt, SAM3_Detect returns the union mask, MaskToImage and SaveImage export it as PNG.

Direct ComfyUI 0.37.0 / RTX 4090 probe on 2026-10-19 with a 1920x1072 photo of people on a giant chessboard: prompts 'hair', 'face' and 'jacket' each returned a 1920x1072 mask in 7.4 s (cold), 2.0 s and 1.0 s. 'hair' isolated the visible woman's hair and 'jacket' one man's jacket at threshold 0.5; the packaged default is lowered to 0.35 so more matching objects pass. Segmentation accuracy on other images and edge quality are not proven.
